title: Women's Cat – Clocked It. Said Nothing. Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Cat Lady Zip Up Hoodie – Clocked It. Said Nothing.
seo.description: A cat lady zip up hoodie: CLOCKED IT. SAID NOTHING. on the back around a side-eye cat face line drawing, plus an embroidered side-eye cat on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This cat lady zip up hoodie is for the woman who notices everything and says nothing, zipped on for the sofa, the vet waiting room and the long stare across the kitchen.

A single-line drawing of a cat's face with pointed ears, narrowed side-eyes and a flat mouth, stitched-looking in one thin line with a worn print texture. CLOCKED IT. runs above it and SAID NOTHING. below in tall condensed capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: cream and pink on Black and Navy, navy and berry on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small side-eye cat face is embroidered on the left chest, and the word CLOCKED is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest side-eye cat face and left-cuff CLOCKED, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Clocked It. Said Nothing. zip hoodie fit?
The Clocked It. Said Nothing. cat lady zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this cat lady hoodie warm enough for a drafty apartment?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles drafty apartments, cold vet waiting rooms and long evenings on the sofa well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, CLOCKED IT. above the art and SAID NOTHING. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small side-eye cat face sits on the left chest with no words, and CLOCKED is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The side-eye cat face on the chest and the CLOCKED cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a cat person, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who talks to her cat and is judged right back. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
